title: Spider Dribble Drill
description: A rapid-fire combo drill cycling through crossover, between-the-legs and behind-the-back dribbles without stopping, building hand speed under fatigue.

content.objective: Keep the ball under control through a fast, continuous combination of dribble moves.
content.setup: Each player stands in an athletic stance with a ball and open space around them.
instructions: Crossover low, then immediately go between the legs without a pause.
Follow with a behind-the-back move on the next touch.
Cycle the combination continuously for 30 seconds without stopping the ball.
Rest 15 seconds and repeat for three more sets.
coachingPoints: Keep every dribble low even as the combination speeds up.
Breathe and stay relaxed through the shoulders.
Keep the eyes up for the last two sets to simulate game vision.
commonMistakes: Rushing the combination until control breaks down.
Letting the ball ride higher as fatigue sets in.
Speeding up until control breaks down, instead of building speed gradually.
content.safety: Stop the set immediately if control is lost rather than chasing the ball into traffic.
